task.description:
WF-03 Step 1: Root cause diagnosis for ISS-0128.

Issue: event_store/store.zig:337 StoreError.InstanceNotFound on TC-DB-03-01 store.append

Context from ISS file:
- Failure occurs after successful tenant provisioning (ISS-0114 was fixed)
- TC-DB-03-01 calls store.append but gets InstanceNotFound
- The instance was just provisioned but event_store cannot locate it
- Candidate: race between tenant schema visibility commit and event_store.lookup
- Candidate: event_store.lookup relies on search_path instead of schema-qualified table names

Diagnose:
1. Read src/event_store/store.zig around line 337 - what query fails?
2. Check if event_store.lookup qualifies table names with schema or uses search_path
3. Review TC-DB-03-01 test flow in tests/integration/db_integration_test.zig
4. Determine if commit barrier is needed OR if lookup needs schema qualification
5. Check for similar patterns in related ISS entries

Write diagnosis report to docs/issue-reports/ISS-0128-diagnosis.yaml

result.summary: Root cause diagnosed: event_store.zig::append() lacks SET LOCAL search_path after BEGIN, causing instance_projections lookup to fail when pooled connection carries stale session-level search_path. Same pattern as ISS-0130 (PR #531). Fix: add SET LOCAL search_path immediately after BEGIN, before any query.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER (WF-03 Step 2) for fix design
